data.confirmBackupBody: The backup is unencrypted and may contain clipboard history.
data.confirmExportBody: The export is unencrypted and contains clipboard content.
data.confirmImportBody: Imported clips are merged into the current database after validation.
data.confirmOptimizeBody: This can temporarily make the database unavailable while it reclaims space.

data.unencryptedWarning: Ditto v1 stores the database and exports without encryption. Handle backups as sensitive files.
general.languageHelp: Changing the language requires a restart.
general.logLevelHelp: Debug logs may include full local paths. Clipboard content is never logged.
general.runAtStartupHelp: Uses the current-user startup entry. No administrator access is needed.
general.showTrayIconHelp: The tray menu can reopen settings and show the popup.
general.singleInstanceHelp: A second launch forwards its command to the running core.
general.startMinimizedHelp: The tray and global hotkey remain available.
general.startupMessageHelp: Leave empty to show no startup message.
general.startupMessagePlaceholder: Optional message shown when Ditto starts
general.updatesComingLater: Automatic updates are not available in this version.
groups.defaultGroupHelp: New clips may be assigned to this group when a capture rule requests it.
groups.deleteBody: Child groups are deleted and clips are moved to Ungrouped. This action cannot be undone.
groups.empty: No groups yet. Create one to organize clips.
groups.promptForName: Prompt for a group name when creating groups
groups.showGroupedInMain: Show grouped clips in the main list
history.deleteBody: The clip is removed from the history. This action cannot be undone.
history.editHelp: Only the text preview and searchable text are updated. Raw clipboard formats remain unchanged in real storage.
hotkeys.firstTen: Use Ctrl+number for the first ten clips
hotkeys.globalPlain: Global shortcut: pastes the most recent clip as plain text.
hotkeys.cutNotGlobal: Cut is not a global shortcut in v1; it needs a selection inside the popup.
hotkeys.notImplemented: This chord is shown for reference and is not registered yet.
hotkeys.recording: Press a shortcut, or press Escape to cancel.
hotkeys.worksWhenOpen: Works while the popup is open.
i18n.fallback: Some labels fell back to English: {keys}
languages.restart: Language changes are saved with Apply and require a restart.

webview2.missingBody:
Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is required to show Ditto Settings.

Install the Evergreen Runtime from:
https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?LinkId=2124703

Ditto will keep running in the background.
